title: Paper-fixed last-four / first-four trading-day rebalancing transfer to US500 cash-session economics
user_boundary: The repository-integrity patch and Units 108-110 are closed on origin/main. The user instructed the continuous Live-derived Optimization research to resume. This is one serial Lab research detour that may retain one information seed but grants no Optimization candidate, MT5 shortlist, deployment, promotion or Live authority by itself.

research_height.transfer_path: A paper-fixed monthly institutional rebalancing interval must survive exact NYSE session ranking, broker bid/ask cost, time splits, role decomposition, rest-of-month and unconditional controls, post-paper years and the latest period before one additive information seed can exist.

central_question: Does the exact final-four plus first-four official NYSE-session interval carry positive and relatively superior US500 09:30..16:00 ET LONG cash-session economics after doubled FPMarkets spread cost, including 2024-2026 evidence outside the source paper's sample?
economic_hypothesis: If infrequent institutional rebalancing and risk deferral create a genuine turn-of-month equity premium, both PRE4 and POST4 cash-session roles should be profitable, the pooled eight-session mean should exceed rest-of-month and unconditional daily means, and the effect should remain positive across 2024, 2025, early 2026 and June-July 2026 rather than being a historical or overnight-only artifact.

literature_anchor.title: Infrequent rebalancing, risk deferral, and equity returns at the turn of the month
literature_anchor.author: Nuri Volkan Kayacetin
literature_anchor.journal: Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money
frozen_facts: Its expanded turn-of-month interval is exactly the final four trading days of one calendar month and first four trading days of the next.
The source attributes the pattern to infrequent institutional rebalancing and deferral of risk near month-end.
The source reports that the effect is particularly pronounced in the United States during 2019-2023.
The paper sample ends in 2023, so every project observation from 2024 onward is chronologically outside that sample.
literature_anchor.translation_limit: This unit does not claim exact index-total-return, close-to-close, overnight, futures, cash-equity or cross-country replication. It tests one publication-fixed interval on an executable US500 CFD regular-cash-session path with no overnight carry and no searched clock, width, direction or symbol.

supporting_mechanism_anchor.title: Dash for Cash: Month-End Liquidity Needs and the Predictability of Stock Returns
supporting_mechanism_anchor.use: Mechanism context only: institutional settlement and payment-cycle cash needs can concentrate equity demand around month-end. It does not supply a second interval, threshold or candidate.

premetric_design_corrections.fault: The first outcome-free geometry ranked every weekday CFD cash date observed in the broker bars, including dates when NYSE equities were officially closed.
premetric_design_corrections.correction: Rank an explicit official NYSE equities session calendar built from the frozen 2022-2026 NYSE calendars and special 2025-01-09 closure. CFD-only holiday dates are ignored; official sessions retain rank even when broker bars are absent.

premetric_design_corrections.fault: The corrected official-calendar premetric initially required all 26 interior M15 bars even though the fixed treatment consumes only the exact 09:30 entry and 15:45 exit bars.
premetric_design_corrections.correction: Freeze trade eligibility to presence of both exact boundary bars, report full 26-bar geometry separately, and preserve official early-close or broker-closed dates in rank while excluding them when a boundary is absent.

official_calendar_freeze.construction: Every weekday from the first through last observed ET date minus 42 official NYSE closure dates inside that range.
official_calendar_freeze.selected_boundary_ineligible_meaning: Each date retains its official PRE4 rank but contributes no trade because either the exact 09:30 entry or 15:45 exit bar is absent.
official_calendar_freeze.interior_gap_reason: Both fixed boundary bars exist, so absent interior M15 bars cannot alter the declared open-to-close trade.

fixed_calendar_rule.PRE4: Final four official NYSE equities sessions of each calendar month.
fixed_calendar_rule.POST4: First four official NYSE equities sessions of each calendar month.
fixed_calendar_rule.ROM: Every other official NYSE equities session.
fixed_calendar_rule.overlap: Forbidden; role assignment is made before any broker coverage exclusion.
fixed_calendar_rule.early_close: Retain official rank; exclude from trade only when a fixed boundary bar is absent.

fixed_trade_rule.eligible_target: Every official PRE4 or POST4 session in a declared period with exact 09:30 and 15:45 ET M15 boundary bars.
fixed_trade_rule.gross: Entry midpoint to exit midpoint P/L.
fixed_trade_rule.observed: Executable entry ask to exit bid; gross less half of entry-plus-exit spread burden.
fixed_trade_rule.stressed: Gross less the full entry-plus-exit spread burden; binding doubled-cost measure.
fixed_trade_rule.commission_swap_financing: Zero because every position closes inside one regular cash session.
fixed_trade_rule.drawdown: Closed-balance cumulative daily path; proxy drawdown cannot prove native floating-equity DD.

premetric_feasibility.scope: Only immutable bytes/schema, timestamps, official session rank, broker boundary availability, roles, periods and counts were opened.

economic_gates.density: TOM_ALL must contain at least 100/60/60/24/8 days in P1/P2/P3/P4/P5.
economic_gates.p1: P1 stressed net >0, PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25, all three P1 splits positive, both PRE4 and POST4 positive, and pooled mean/day above ROM and unconditional controls.
economic_gates.confirmation: P2, P3 and P4 TOM_ALL stressed nets each >0; at least 5/6 PRE4/POST4 period cells positive; pooled mean/day above ROM in at least 2/3 periods.
economic_gates.prelatest: P1-P4 PF >=1.075, net/DD >=1.50, at least 60% positive active months, top-five positive-day share <=35%, and mean/day above ROM and unconditional controls.
economic_gates.drawdown: Nominal closed DD <=20.0%; practical closed DD <=21.2%, recorded separately.
economic_gates.latest: P5 stressed net >=0 nominally; practical floor permits reversal no worse than one quarter of positive prelatest mean/day times latest-day count.
economic_gates.full: P1-P5 stressed net >0, PF >=1.05 and net/DD >=1.25.
economic_gates.retention_limit: At most one exact FIXED_LAST4_FIRST4_US500_CASH_SESSION_LONG information seed.
